facts.text: John has been exploring options to channel his energy into something meaningful.

evidence.quote: Lately I've been exploring options. One idea I had was to join local organizations or volunteering programs. Maybe that's an option.

facts.text: Maria suggested that John research and explore organizations that align with his beliefs.

evidence.quote: You can meet like-minded people and contribute to causes that you care about. Why not do some research and explore the organizations you'd be interested in?

facts.text: John plans to make a list of organizations that align with his beliefs and reach out for more information.
